coverage_notes.limitations: A bounded search-index recall is not an exhaustive national/territory census; weekend lag may conceal newly effective local service changes. Authoritative production Care Line collection and any review queue were not accessed, so deduplication reflects the verified supplementary ledger and known previous findings rather than exhaustive production comparison. No newly qualifying event was confirmed.
coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approval, public posting, production collection change, schedule change, or disablement.
